DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 新しい住所を確認します。こちらの地名はどう読みますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: I'll check your new address. How do you pronounce this place name?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: すみません。漢字は契約書から写しましたが、読み方に自信がありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 地名の読みだけ分からないと申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Sorry. I copied the kanji from the contract, but I'm not confident about the pronunciation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that only the place name's pronunciation is unclear. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 資料で確認しましょう。番地と部屋番号はお分かりですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's check the documents. Do you know the street number and apartment number?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。番地はこの数字、部屋番号は三〇一です。地名だけ教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 番地と部屋番号を資料で示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. The street number is this number, and the apartment is 301. Please just tell me the place name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the street and apartment numbers in your document. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらの読み方です。申請書のふりがな欄にも記入してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: It's pronounced like this. Please also fill in the furigana field on the application.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。この文字は長く伸ばして読むんですね。私の書いた読みは直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 教わった読みを反復し訂正を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Thank you. So this character has a long vowel. I'll correct the pronunciation I wrote.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Repeat the pronunciation you were taught and ask for a correction. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 訂正の方法をご案内します。住所の漢字そのものは変えないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll explain how to correct it. Please don't change the address's kanji themselves.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 漢字はそのまま、ふりがなを直しました。声に出して一度確認してもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 漢字を保ってふりがなを直し確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I've kept the kanji and corrected the furigana. Could you listen while I say it aloud once to check?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Keep the kanji, correct the furigana, and check. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。今おっしゃった読みで合っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. The pronunciation you just used is correct.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 電話で住所を聞かれた時も、この読みと番地で伝えます。控えを残したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 住所を口頭で伝えるため控えを求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: When asked my address on the phone, I'll give this pronunciation and the street number. I'd like to keep a copy.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask for a copy so you can give your address verbally. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 案内をお渡しします。記載内容を最後にご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll give you the information sheet. Please check the written details one last time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 明日の予約についてですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: This is about tomorrow's appointment, right?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。急に出張になり、別の日へ変えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 翌日予約の変更理由を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I suddenly have a business trip and would like to move it to another day.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain why you need to change tomorrow's appointment. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今週は空きがありません。来週の候補を担当へ確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: There are no openings this week. I'll check next week's options with the person responsible.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 来週でも大丈夫です。ただ、明日の時間には絶対に来られません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 空きがなくても受診不能だと明言する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Next week is fine. But I definitely cannot come at tomorrow's time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Make clear that you cannot attend even if there are no openings. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: では、明日の予約をどう扱うかも担当に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Then I'll also ask how to handle tomorrow's booking.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 新しい日が決まるまで、明日の予約をそのまま放置してよいとは思っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 日未確定でも欠席連絡は必要だと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I don't think I should leave tomorrow's appointment unattended until a new date is decided.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you need to report your absence even if a new date is not fixed. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 欠席の連絡として伝えます。予約票を見せてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll report it as notice that you cannot attend. Please show your appointment slip.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: こちらです。検査も同じ日にあります。診察だけの変更で済むか見てください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 同日検査の調整も頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Here it is. I also have a test on the same day. Please check whether changing only the consultation would be enough.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask for the same-day test to be rescheduled too. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 検査担当にも確認が必要です。折り返しご連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: We need to check with the testing staff too. We'll call you back.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 連絡先はこの番号です。明日は受診できないことと、両方の日程調整をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 連絡先と二つの用件をまとめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: My contact number is this one. Please tell them I cannot attend tomorrow and arrange new dates for both.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Summarize your contact details and the two requests. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。診察と検査の担当へ引き継ぎます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I'll pass this on to the consultation and testing staff.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 自転車の写真をお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have a photo of the bicycle?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。この写真です。ただ、撮った後で前のかごを交換しました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 写真が現在と違うことを先に説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes, this photo. But I replaced the front basket after taking it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain first that the photo differs from its current condition. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今のかごはどのような物ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: What is the basket like now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 黒い金属製です。写真の白いかごではありません。車体の色は同じ青です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 交換したかごと車体色を答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: It's black and made of metal. Not the white basket in the photo. The frame is still the same blue.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Describe the replacement basket and frame colour. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ほかに写真と違う部分はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Is anything else different from the photo?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ベルも赤に変えました。記録に写真だけ付くと、別の自転車を探すことになりませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: ベルの変更も加え写真だけの記録を懸念する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I changed the bell to red too. If only the photo is kept in the record, won't that mean looking for a different bicycle?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Add the bell change and express concern about a photo-only record. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 変更した特徴を文章でも残します。登録番号の控えもありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll record the changed features in writing too. Do you also have a copy of the registration number?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この控えです。番号は交換していないので、そのままです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 変わらない登録番号を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Here's the copy. I haven't changed the number, so it remains the same.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show the unchanged registration number. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: なくなった場所と気付いた時刻をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please tell me where it went missing and when you noticed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 学校前の駐輪場で、今日四時に気付きました。今の部品の説明を写真に添えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 場所時刻と写真への補足を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: At the bicycle parking area in front of the school; I noticed at four today. Please attach the description of the current parts to the photo.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Give the location, time, and additional details for the photo. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。写真は参考とし、変更後の特徴を記録します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We'll use the photo as a reference and record the features after the changes.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 発送する封筒は、準備ができていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is the envelope you're sending ready?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: ほぼできました。家にあった封筒を使うのですが、底に別の紙が残っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 再利用する封筒に別の紙が残っていると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Almost. I'm using an envelope I had at home, but there's another paper left at the bottom.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say there is another paper left in the reused envelope. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今回送る書類とは別の物ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Is it separate from the documents you're sending this time?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。以前の同居人の明細です。入っているとは知りませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 今回とは別の同居人の明細だと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. It's a statement belonging to my former housemate. I didn't know it was inside.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain it is a housemate's statement unrelated to this submission. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 今回の申請書と混ざる前に、別にしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please separate it before it gets mixed with this application.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 元の封筒の中身まで見ずに使っていました。新しい封筒へ替えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 中身未確認の再利用を見直し新しい封筒を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I was reusing the envelope without checking all the original contents. I'd like to change to a new envelope.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Reconsider reusing an unchecked envelope and request a new one. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: どうぞ。宛先の書き直しと、今回の書類の確認をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please do. Rewrite the destination and check this submission's documents.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 古い明細は誰にも送らず分けます。今回の一覧にある三枚だけを入れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 古い個人書類を分け今回の三枚だけ入れると言う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll separate the old personal statement without sending it to anyone. I'll enclose only the three sheets on this submission's list.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will separate the old personal document and enclose only the current three sheets. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 新しい封筒が整ったら、窓口へお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Once the new envelope is ready, please bring it to the counter.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 三枚を確認して入れました。古い明細と古い封筒は自分の袋へ戻し、新しい方だけ出します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 新旧封筒と内容を分離して発送用を指定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've checked and enclosed the three sheets. I've put the old statement and envelope back in my bag, and will submit only the new one.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Separate the old and new envelopes and contents, and identify the one to send. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。発送するのはこちらの新しい封筒ですね。確認して受け付けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. This new envelope is the one to send, then. We'll check and accept it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お申込みの進捗についてですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking about your application's progress?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。会社に今日までに口座番号を出すよう言われました。番号はもう決まっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 会社の提出期限と番号発行状況を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. My company told me to submit my account number by today. Has the number been assigned yet?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about the company's deadline and account-number issuance. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今は確認中で、開設が完了した状態ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: It's currently being checked; the account has not finished opening.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 申込みの控えを番号の代わりに出しても、給与を受け取れるとは限らないんですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 申込控えでは受取口座にならないと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: So even if I submit the application receipt instead of a number, it doesn't necessarily mean I can receive my salary.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm that an application receipt is not a receiving account. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。給与担当には確認中であることをお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes. Tell payroll that it's still being checked.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 結果が出る時刻は分かりますか。今日中と約束しない方がよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 結果時刻が未確定か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Do you know what time the result will be available? Should I avoid promising it will be today?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask whether the result time is still unconfirmed. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 現時点で時刻のお約束はできません。連絡方法を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: We can't promise a time at this point. Let's confirm how to contact you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この電話番号へ連絡をお願いします。会社には、提出期限を延ばせるか相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 連絡先を示し会社へ期限調整を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please call this telephone number. I'll ask my company whether they can extend the submission deadline.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Provide your contact details and ask the company to adjust the deadline. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 開設結果を受けてから、利用できる口座の情報を提出してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: After receiving the account-opening result, submit the information for the account you can use.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。番号を推測して書かず、今は申込み中とだけ伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 番号を推測せず申込中と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I won't guess and write a number; for now I'll just say the application is in progress.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Avoid guessing the number and say the application is pending. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: そのようにお願いします。連絡先に変更があればお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please do that. Let us know if your contact details change.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 会員価格についてお尋ねですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking about the member price?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。アプリを入れたので、この価格で買えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: アプリ所持で会員価格になるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I've installed the app, so can I buy it at this price?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether having the app qualifies you for the member price. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 会員登録と会計時の提示が必要な商品です。会員画面は出せますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: This item requires membership registration and showing it at checkout. Can you display the membership screen?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだ登録していません。アプリを入れるだけでは足りないんですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 会員登録が未完了と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I haven't registered yet. Just installing the app isn't enough, then.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that membership registration is unfinished. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。登録方法の案内はありますが、今すぐの完了は保証できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: That's right. We have registration instructions, but can't guarantee immediate completion.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 後ろの人を待たせたくないので、今日は通常価格で買うといくらですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 今日は通常価格を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I don't want to keep the people behind waiting. How much is it at the regular price today?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check today's regular price. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 通常価格はこちらの三百円です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: The regular price is the three hundred yen shown here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 三百円なら買います。会員登録は会計の後、時間のある時にします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 会計後に登録する方針を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll buy it for three hundred yen. I'll register after checkout when I have time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Decide to register after checkout. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。ほかの商品も通常価格で確認しますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. We'll check the regular prices for your other items too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。会員の札だけを見て予算を計算したので、合計も一度見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 予算計算を見直すため合計を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please do. I worked out my budget using only the member labels, so I'd like to see the total again.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask for the total to revise your budget calculation. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 会計前に合計をお伝えします。ご確認いただいてからお支払いください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: We'll tell you the total before checkout. Please check it before paying.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 散歩のコースをお選びですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you choosing a walking route?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。父と一周したいです。父はあちらで座っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 父と長い周回を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I'd like to walk a full circuit with my father. He's sitting over there.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want a long circuit with your father. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 長い道だと坂があります。お父様はその距離を希望されていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: The long path has slopes. Does your father want that distance?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだ聞いていません。私が歩きたい距離で決めていました。聞いて来ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 本人に距離を聞いていないと認める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I haven't asked him yet. I was choosing based on how far I wanted to walk. I'll go and ask him.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Acknowledge you have not asked him about the distance. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: お待ちしています。短い平坦な道もあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: We'll wait. There's also a short, level path.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 父は、今日は疲れているので少しだけ歩きたいそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 父の疲れと希望を確認して伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: My father says he's tired today and only wants a short walk.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check and report your father's tiredness and preference. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: では、花壇までの平坦な道はいかがでしょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Then how about the level path to the flower bed?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 父もそれなら歩きたいと言っています。途中で戻れる道ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 短い道に同意し引き返せるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: My father says he'd like to walk that one too. Can we turn back along the way?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Agree to the short path and ask whether you can turn back. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 同じ道を引き返せます。ベンチも一つあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: You can return along the same path. There's one bench too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 花壇までにして、途中でも父が疲れたら戻ります。地図を父にも見せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 父の状態に合わせ戻る条件を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: We'll only go as far as the flower bed and turn back if Father gets tired along the way. I'll show him the map too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Set a condition for returning based on your father's condition. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どうぞ。お二人のペースでお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please do. Enjoy it at your own pace together.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 乗換ホームはこの先です。お急ぎですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: The transfer platform is ahead. Are you in a hurry?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 十分あります。その前に売店で土産を買えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 乗換時間内の買物を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have ten minutes. Can I buy a souvenir at the shop first?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about shopping within your transfer time. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 売店には列ができています。会計後にホームまで移動する時間も必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: There's a queue at the shop. You also need time to get to the platform after paying.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 十分全部を買物に使えるわけではないんですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 移動時間も含むと理解する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: So I can't use all ten minutes for shopping.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show that you understand travel time is included too. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。一本遅らせるか、買物を後にするかお考えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes. Consider taking the following train or shopping later.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 次の列車なら友人との約束に遅れます。今日は先にホームへ行きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 約束への影響から買物を後回しにする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Taking the next train would make me late to meet my friend. I'll go to the platform first today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Postpone shopping because of the effect on your appointment. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: では、この通路を進んで階段の上の表示をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Then go down this passage and check the signs at the top of the stairs.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 途中で空いている店があっても寄らずに行きます。乗換先は同じ改札内ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 寄り道をやめ改札を出るか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Even if I see a shop without a queue, I won't stop. Is the connecting service within the same ticket gates?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Avoid a detour and ask whether you leave the ticket gates. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. You don't go out through the gates.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 切符をしまい、乗換表示を見て進みます。土産は到着してから買います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 切符を保ち到着後に買うと決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll put my ticket away and follow the transfer signs. I'll buy a souvenir after arriving.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Keep your ticket and decide to shop after arriving. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その方が余裕があります。ホームの案内をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: That gives you more time. Please check the platform information.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 世帯全員と一部のどちらをご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like all household members or only some?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家族全員です。別の市に住む姉も載せたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 別居姉も含めた家族の証明を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: All my family. I'd like to include my older sister who lives in another city too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for family certification including your separately living older sister. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ここでいう世帯は、単に家族全員という意味ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Here, household doesn't simply mean every member of your family.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 姉は別に暮らしています。私と妻だけの世帯なら、この紙に姉は載らないんですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 世帯と家族の違いを確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: My sister lives separately. If my household is just my wife and me, my sister won't appear on this paper.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm the difference between household and family. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 登録上の世帯を確認します。提出先は誰の情報を求めていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: We'll check the registered household. Whose information does the recipient require?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 私と妻の情報です。姉は関係ありません。家族と言われたので広く考えていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 提出に必要な本人と妻の範囲を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Mine and my wife's. My sister isn't relevant. They said family, so I interpreted it broadly.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: State that only you and your wife are required for submission. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その指定なら、必要な範囲で申請してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Then apply for the range required by those instructions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 私と妻が載るか、記録を確認してから世帯全員を選びたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 登録を確認して申請範囲を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'd like to check the record to see if my wife and I are included, then select all household members.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check the registration and decide the application scope. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認します。不要な情報の記載指定もありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll check. Are there instructions about information that should not be included too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 提出先のこの用紙です。これに合わせて項目も選びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 提出先の項目指定を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Here's the recipient's form. I'll select the fields according to it too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Show the recipient's required fields. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 用紙を拝見し、申請の範囲をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: We'll look at the form and explain the scope of the application.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 手の症状について、こちらの欄をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Please fill in this field about the symptoms in your hand.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 「しびれ」は痛いという意味ですか。日本語で説明しにくいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: しびれの意味を痛みと比較して聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Does “numbness” mean pain? It's hard to explain in Japanese.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask the meaning of numbness by comparing it with pain. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 痛みとは別に、ピリピリしたり感覚が鈍くなったりする状態です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: It's different from pain, such as tingling or reduced sensation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 指先がピリピリします。針で強く刺すような痛みはありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: ピリピリする感覚を具体化する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: My fingertips tingle. I don't have strong pain like being stabbed by a needle.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Describe the tingling sensation concretely. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: どの指で、いつ感じましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Which fingers, and when did you feel it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 右の親指と人差し指です。今朝から感じます。ずっと同じ強さではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 指と開始時期と強弱を答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: My right thumb and index finger. I've felt it since this morning. It isn't always the same strength.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Give the fingers, onset time, and variation in intensity. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その内容を記入し、看護師へ伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll record that and tell the nurse.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 一度消えたことも書きたいです。今なくても症状なしと答えない方がいいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 消えた症状も記録したいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'd also like to write that it went away once. Even if it's gone now, I shouldn't just answer “no symptoms”, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you also want to record symptoms that disappeared. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 消えた時刻と再び感じた時刻を、分かる範囲でお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please give the time it disappeared and the time you felt it again, as far as you know.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 昼には消え、二時ごろまた感じました。診察でもこの順に説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 再発の時系列を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: It went away at noon and I felt it again around two. I'll explain in that order during the consultation too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain the timeline of the recurrence. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。変化があれば待ち時間中もお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please let us know of any changes while you are waiting too.
